messages: Definitions (WHO 2021): Hr-TB = isoniazid-resistant, rifampicin-susceptible; RR-TB = rifampicin-resistant; MDR-TB = rifampicin + isoniazid; pre-XDR-TB = RR/MDR-TB + any fluoroquinolone; XDR-TB = pre-XDR-TB + bedaquiline and/or linezolid.
This is a genotypic classification. Treatment decisions follow national guidelines and the treating clinician's judgement.
